notes: Built with default-features = false and the rust_crypto feature (pure-Rust hmac and sha2), since the crate needs a backend chosen; aws_lc_rs may differ. Validation::new(HS256) checks signature and exp.
details: Not the default feature set: built with default-features = false and the rust_crypto feature. The crate ships no crypto backend by default and needs one of rust_crypto or aws_lc_rs chosen; rust_crypto (pure-Rust hmac and sha2) is used here, and aws_lc_rs may perform differently. Turning default features off drops only use_pem, PEM key loading, which an HMAC secret does not use. Validation::new(HS256) checks the signature, the algorithm and exp.
